usb_report_pacing.scope: SCENE_UNIFIED printing, after close and outside measured interval
usb_report_pacing.reason: USB Serial/JTAG lost end-of-case burst in VoCat first 0-degree capture; incomplete row will be rerun

reset.s31-qspi: official esptool watchdog-reset; hard reset stayed in download mode
reset.p4-dsi: official esptool watchdog-reset for subsequent captures; initial USB reset boot faults before app_main preserved and retried

metadata_correction: Grouped controller selected PARTIAL case by name/angle only. Export and completion supervisor verify tile count from each image manifest and on-board buffer audit.

p4_completion_retries.policy: First complete valid result is retained; successful cases in supplemental Cartesian images are ignored, never selected by score. No SDK / XIP / clock changes.
p4_completion_retries.memory: Startup faults before app_main were recovered using an independent subset image with the same runtime and comparable SDK configuration; all 254 memory samples validated.
p4_completion_retries.failure_interpretation: A pre-app Store access fault is not evidence of a Presenter runtime fault. A post-RUN stall is recorded separately.

archive_naming: Completion archives include implementation, mode, angle, tile count and retry index, preventing same-angle FULL/PARTIAL case names from colliding. The scheduler was paused between child processes to fix naming; no firmware flash was interrupted.
